# MASR release pipeline

Development lands on `dev`. Merge `dev` into `main` to start the **Publish
release** workflow. It builds Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel,
and Linux x64 from the merged MASR source, then creates a release in
`RealNickey/runtime-depot`.

The workflow derives a monotonically increasing SemVer patch version from the
development version in `package.json` plus the GitHub Actions run number. It
applies that exact version to `package.json`, `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`, and
`src-tauri/Cargo.toml` in each isolated build. The source checkout is not
committed back to `main` just to publish a version.

After every platform build succeeds, the workflow creates `latest.json` with
the signed Windows NSIS, macOS app archive, and Linux AppImage updater assets,
and uploads both the manifest and installable artifacts to the depot release.

## Required repository secrets

Configure these **in `RealNickey/MASR`**, not in the public depot:

| Secret                               | Purpose                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `RUNTIME_DEPOT_TOKEN`                | Fine-grained personal access token with **Contents: Read and write** on `RealNickey/runtime-depot`. It creates releases and uploads all assets. |
| `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY`          | The complete private updater key generated by `bun tauri signer generate`.                                                                      |
| `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD` | Password for that updater key; leave the value empty only if the key truly has no password.                                                     |
| `APPLE_CERTIFICATE`                  | Base64-encoded Developer ID Application `.p12` certificate.                                                                                     |
| `APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD`         | Password for that `.p12` file.                                                                                                                  |
| `KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD`                  | Random, CI-only temporary keychain password.                                                                                                    |
| `APPLE_ID`                           | Apple ID used for notarization.                                                                                                                 |
| `APPLE_PASSWORD`                     | Apple app-specific password used for notarization.                                                                                              |
| `APPLE_TEAM_ID`                      | Apple Developer Team ID.                                                                                                                        |
| `AZURE_CLIENT_ID`                    | Azure Trusted Signing app client ID for Windows code signing, if configured.                                                                    |
| `AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET`                | Azure Trusted Signing app client secret, if configured.                                                                                         |
| `AZURE_TENANT_ID`                    | Azure tenant ID for Windows code signing, if configured.                                                                                        |

`TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY` must match the public key already committed in
`src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`. Treat `RUNTIME_DEPOT_TOKEN` and every signing
value as a GitHub Actions secret; never place them in workflow files or local
commits.

## Branch protection

Set `dev` as the default development branch and require its Development Build
workflow before merging pull requests. Protect `main` so it accepts only a
reviewed merge from `dev`; a push to `main` is a production publication.
